constraints: This command only works with project methods.
If called from a component you must pass the trailing '*' parameter (by default it applies to the component's own methods); '*' redirects it to the host database's methods.

jointConstraints.rule: path and attributes must be passed as the same kind: either both a scalar (Text path, Object attributes) or both an array (Text array path, Object array attributes) of matching length; you cannot mix a scalar with an array.
